answer: Each submission needs cosignature from 2 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 30 submissions per epoch. Cosignatures are collected in nebula, verified in ferrous, and umber names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Repeating the trick 35 times costs 6 separate deposits and 14 separate proofs of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
